content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with a [article_no] [product_name] (8 digital inputs and 4 digital outputs). When I select "[article_no].Standard" in the [product_name] software, only 6 digital inputs are shown. Where can I adjust this? Thank you!
The [product_name] with article number [article_no] is actually a [article_no] version, not [article_no]. To select the correct version in the device selection, choose "[product_name] FS4".
When I select "[product_name] FS4," the software shows 24 digital inputs—is this expected? How can I identify the correct hardware version in the future? Thank you!

A [product_name] [article_no] version can handle up to: - 24 digital inputs - 20 digital outputs - 8 analog inputs - 8 analog outputs To determine correct hardware selection in the future: stay informed with product updates or refer to the manual for your [product_name].
Alright, thank you for your assistance!

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced difficulty identifying the right hardware configuration in the [product_name] software, as there was a disconnect between the version selected and their actual device, resulting in confusion about available inputs. Community responses clarified how to match hardware and software versions and advised consulting documentation for accuracy. The situation highlights the challenge of non-intuitive version selection in configuration tools for users unfamiliar with multiple hardware iterations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward way to select the correct device version in the configuration software, aiming for reliable alignment between hardware and software without requiring extensive manual verification.
